context_requirements: Expression of glutathione transferases (especially GSTP1) or GCLM, the annotated target
Intact oxidative stress response (KEAP1-NFE2L2) for transcriptional feedback
Functional p53 for apoptotic and cell-cycle transcriptional responses
Low baseline antioxidant capacity so that GST inhibition causes redox imbalance
falsifiers: No change in NFE2L2 target genes (HMOX1, TXNRD1, GCLM, SQSTM1) at 6 or 24 h in any line
No induction of p53 targets (CDKN1A, GADD45A, PMAIP1) at 24 h in TP53-wild-type lines
No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines, including lines with low GST expression
No evidence of apoptosis or oxidative stress programs at 24 h

evidence.supports: GSTP1 inhibitor NBDHEX induces apoptosis and p53 phosphorylation in A375 melanoma cells
Glutathione transferase degraders induce apoptosis in cancer cells
